questions.question: True or false: Rav Yosef was blind.
options: True
False
questions.explanation: He was called "sagi nahor." His figure combines great wealth, blindness and a phenomenal memory.

questions.question: What is the meaning of the epithet "Sinai" given to Rav Yosef?
options: Expert in all the sources of the Oral Torah, arranged in his head as they were given
Sharp and dialectical, dissolving difficulties by reasoning
One who immigrated from Babylonia to the Land of Israel
One who used to fast for forty days
questions.explanation: Mishnah, baraita, Tosefta and halakhic midrashim were arranged in his head "as they were given at the assembly at Mount Sinai."

questions.question: Who was the "Uprooter of Mountains," Rav Yosef's colleague?
options: Abaye
Rabba bar Nachmani
Rava
Rav Yehuda bar Yechezkel
questions.explanation: Rabba excelled in sharpness and pilpul, the ability to dissolve difficulties and resolve contradictions through reasoning.

questions.question: True or false: When the sages of the Land of Israel were asked who takes precedence, they answered: "The Uprooter of Mountains is preferable."
options: True
False
questions.explanation: The answer was decisive: "Sinai is preferable."

questions.question: What was the reasoning for the ruling "Sinai is preferable"?
options: Rav Yosef was wealthier than Rabba
So ruled the Head of the Exile
"Everyone needs the master of wheat": everyone needs the owner of the wheat
Rav Yosef was older than Rabba
questions.explanation: Just as the baker needs wheat, the sharp scholar needs the erudite one, who supplies him with the raw materials of halakha.

questions.question: Under whom did Rav Yosef study?
options: Rabbi Yehuda HaNasi
Rav Ashi
Rabbi Yochanan
Rav Yehuda bar Yechezkel, founder of the yeshiva of Pumbedita
questions.explanation: Rav Yehuda was known for his exactitude in the traditions of Rav and Shmuel, and this trait was implanted deeply in Rav Yosef.

questions.question: True or false: Rav Yosef refused to head the yeshiva as long as Rabba was alive.
options: True
False
questions.explanation: Although the sages of the Land of Israel ruled in his favor, he gave Rabba precedence.

questions.question: For how many years did Rabba head the yeshiva, with Rav Yosef giving way to him?
options: 22 years
12 years
40 years
7 years
questions.explanation: Only after Rabba's death did Rav Yosef accept the position, and he served in it for two and a half years until his death.

questions.question: What did Rav Yosef say to the Tanna who taught "When Rabbi died, humility ceased"?
options: "You are right, there is no longer a humble man in the generation"
"Do not teach 'humility,' for I am here"
"Teach it only before students"
"Humility has ceased, but Torah has not"
questions.explanation: That is: do not teach that humility ceased, for I exist. The great teachers of ethics saw in this an inner truth, not pride.

questions.question: How did Rav Yosef express his recognition of Rabba's authority?
options: He did not preach in public all his life
He gave up all his wealth to him
He did not even invite a bloodletter to his house without his permission
He always sat at the end of the study hall
questions.explanation: "He did not even call a craftsman to his house": he did not behave with any trappings of authority in the years that Rabba stood at the head.

questions.question: True or false: According to the rule, wherever Rabba and Rav Yosef disagree, the halakha follows Rav Yosef.
options: True
False
questions.explanation: The rule is "the halakha follows Rabba," with the exception of three cases.

questions.question: What did Abaye do when he saw from afar the ear of Rav Yosef's donkey?
options: Ran to bring him water
Hid his books
Went out to meet him with song
Stood up before him, out of honor for his teacher
questions.explanation: Abaye grew up in the house of Rav Yosef and the house of his uncle Rabba, and was his outstanding disciple.

questions.question: True or false: When Rav Yosef forgot his learning, Rabba bar Nachmani restored it to him.
options: True
False
questions.explanation: Abaye restored it to him: "You yourself told us this, and you learned it from such-and-such a baraita."

questions.question: In which translation of Scripture is Rav Yosef considered the great expert?
options: The translation of Yonatan ben Uziel on the Prophets
The Septuagint translation into Greek
Rasag's translation into Arabic
The Syriac Peshitta
questions.explanation: In many cases he testified that were it not for the translation, he would not have understood the plain meaning of the verses.

questions.question: True or false: On every festival of Shavuot Rav Yosef held a great feast.
options: True
False
questions.explanation: He said: "Were it not for this day that causes it, how many Yosefs there are in the marketplace."

questions.question: What did Rav Yosef explain at the Shavuot feast that he held?
options: That on this day he was born
That without the Torah that was given on this day, there would be another Yosef in the marketplace
That on this day he was chosen as head of the yeshiva
That on this day his learning returned to him
questions.explanation: The Torah is what gave him his identity, his standing and the meaning of his life.

questions.question: What did Rav Yosef change in his opinion about the exemption of the blind from the commandments, and why?
options: He asked to be exempted, because the reward of one who is not commanded is greater
He asked for an exemption from the written commandments only, because he does not read
He asked to be obligated, because "greater is one who is commanded and does than one who is not commanded and does"
He never changed his opinion
questions.explanation: At first he was glad about the opinion of Rabbi Yehuda that a blind person is exempt, but when he heard Rabbi Chanina he asked that they prove that the halakha follows the Sages, who obligate.

questions.question: According to the research, what was the contribution of Rav Yosef and his disciples to the form of the Babylonian Talmud?
options: Giving up pilpul in favor of erudition
Writing the Talmud for the first time
Moving the center of Torah from Babylonia to the Land of Israel
A sharp logical discussion resting on an enormous reservoir of mishnayot and baraitot
questions.explanation: Abaye inherited from him the exact traditions, and Rava combined Rabba's sharpness with the foundation of Rav Yosef.

questions.question: How, according to the research, are "Sinai is preferable" and the rule "the halakha follows Rabba" reconciled?
options: In leadership erudition was preferred, and in deciding halakha Rabba's reasoning generally prevailed
The two rules were stated in different generations and are not related
The rule "the halakha follows Rabba" was annulled when Rav Yosef reigned
Rabba was in fact "Sinai" and Rav Yosef the "Uprooter of Mountains"
questions.explanation: The Chazon Ish explains: where Rav Yosef found no explicit proof in his erudition, the deciding power passed to Rabba's straightforward reasoning.

questions.question: What is the meaning of what was said about Rav Yehuda, Rav Yosef's teacher: "He would even recite the doubts of the transmitters"?
options: That he provided the sages with their livelihood
That he would even pass on the uncertainties about the names of those who transmitted the traditions
That he would recite the whole Talmud in one day
That he was in doubt about every halakha until he had checked it
questions.explanation: This exactitude made Rav Yosef the supreme authority on the exact wording of the mishnayot and baraitot.
